goal: Prevent libbitcoinkernel from reusing cached block validation results across different parameters
Stop invalid blocks from erroneously passing checks when re-evaluated under different consensus rules
agreement: Supports fix noting overhead from re-running context-free checks is minor (yuvicc)

categories.name: kernel
why: P1 because it fixes a correctness failure where invalid blocks erroneously pass subsequent checks
Prevents libbitcoinkernel callers from accepting regtest or mismatched signet blocks as valid
